Question: Have you granted AI plugins or browser extensions “read all site data” access?
Fix (If Not Good): Disable broad permissions; only allow access to the sites/tools required.

Question: Do you fact-check AI outputs before sending them to colleagues or clients?
Fix (If Not Good): Verify with trusted sources; never forward outputs blindly in professional settings.

Question: Do you reuse the same password for AI accounts and other online services?
Fix (If Not Good): AI account logins in a password manager; enforce unique credentials.

Question: Have you checked if the free AI app you use earns money by selling your data or prompts?
Fix (If Not Good): Always read the privacy policy. Prefer trusted vendors with transparent data-handling policies
